ios.desc:
Track real-time crypto prices, stock quotes, and precious metal prices with live community sentiment analysis - all in one free app.

WHAT IS FINVERDICT?
FinVerdict shows you what thousands of investors actually think - bullish or bearish - on any asset. See community sentiment scores alongside live prices for Bitcoin, Tesla, Gold, and more.

Unlike other finance apps, FinVerdict gives you the crowd's verdict, not just the price. Make smarter decisions with real investor sentiment.

FEATURES
- Live prices: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, Dogecoin (DOGE)
- US Stocks: Apple (AAPL), Tesla (TSLA), NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN)
- Precious Metals: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium
- Commodities: Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Wheat, Corn, Coffee, Sugar, Cocoa
- ETFs: SPY, QQQ, VOO, VTI, ARKK and more
- Bullish / Bearish community votes in real-time
- Price charts: 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y
- Community discussions and comments on every asset
- Dark mode support
- 100% Free - no subscription, no hidden fees

MARKETS COVERED
Cryptocurrencies - US Stocks - ETFs - Gold - Silver - Crude Oil - Natural Gas - Wheat - Coffee - Cocoa - Sugar - Soybeans - Commodities

WHY FINVERDICT?
- Real investor community sentiment - not just algorithms
- All markets in one place: crypto, stocks, metals, ETFs
- Free forever - no paywalls
- Clean, fast, and easy to use
- Updated in real-time

Join thousands of investors already using FinVerdict to track markets and make smarter investment decisions.

Download free. Start tracking. Know the verdict.
